mods.name: BuildFromChests
mods.description: Building with the hammer uses materials from chests near you (default 20 m), not just your inventory. The build menu shows how many of each material you have.
mods.notes: The build menu now shows how many of each material you HAVE (inventory plus chests in range) next to how many you need, with the split on hover.

mods.name: BuildOrders
mods.description: Ghost build orders: hold Left Alt and place with the hammer to plan a piece instead of building it. Everyone in the party sees it as a glowing ghost, your placement snaps onto it, and it disappears once built. A panel totals the materials the orders need.
mods.notes: Ghosts are now genuinely see-through (setting: GhostOpacity) instead of a solid glowing copy.

mods.name: CraftFromChests
mods.description: Crafting stations (and hand-crafting from the inventory) use materials from nearby chests. Shows how many of each material you have, buttons beside the crafting tabs show lines to the chests in use and cycle the range (5-30 m).
mods.notes: Hand-crafting from the inventory screen (no crafting station) now uses nearby chests too, measured from you. The window shows how many of each material you HAVE (inventory plus chests) next to how many you need, with the split on hover.

mods.name: FeedFromChests
mods.description: Smelters, kilns, cooking racks, fires and fermenters can use items from nearby chests. Press E at a station (it adds from a chest if you have none, or opens a menu if there's a choice), or look at one and press F for a menu of everything you can add.
mods.notes: Fixes filling adding more than you actually had. Fill is now smooth: it adds a couple per frame and takes from the chests once at the end. The menu opens and runs smoother, has Fill and Fill station, and lists items from lesser to greater (wood, fine wood, core wood...). Feeds smelters, kilns, cooking racks, fires and fermenters from nearby chests.

mods.name: ModUpdater
mods.description: This mod manager (F7). Updates itself like any other mod.
mods.notes: Fix: the F7 hotkey now works while holding Shift (running). Local mods you're still building get their own card with Reload and Disable.

mods.name: PartyHud
mods.description: Party panel on the right of the screen: every player's Steam picture, name, health, stamina and distance, live, at any range.
mods.notes: The panel hides while the inventory, crafting window, build menu, trader or big map is open. Fix: the F8 hide/show key now works while holding Shift (running).

mods.name: QualityOfLife
mods.description: Small controls: Q builds a quick set and swaps to it and back; B jumps into construction mode with your hammer and back; a button under your inventory stacks items into nearby chests, and L locks items you want to keep. Keys are configurable.
mods.notes: Menus open and run smoother: chests are tracked instead of searched for, the item list only draws the rows you can see, and chest tags and hover text are worked out once and reused. Items in the assign menu are listed from lesser to greater. Plus sounds, Undo, chest assignment (K), the stack button, item locking (L), and Q/B working while you run.
